svg.title: SK Arin - Machine learning. Real-world systems.
svg.desc: A dark technical banner for SK Arin in Kolkata. A cyan wireframe surface flows in a seamless twelve-second loop with mint orbital particles and a signal tracing connected nodes. A static version is shown when reduced motion is preferred. Competitive ML, open source, and building in public. A small white silhouette runs and performs parkour across the name, subtitle, and bottom labels, takes three breaths, then remains standing still.
